items.title: Jerry Dodgion interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: And you know it’s like Louis Armstrong called people Pops but he was Pops.

ctx.x: Speaking about — they called him Pops? Benny was “Pops” is that right?

Well Flip called him Pops because he called everybody else Pops. And you know it’s like Louis Armstrong called people Pops but he was Pops. But when he’d talk to you he’d say, “Hey Pops you want to do this?”
